events.item: Leonard stops writing annual shareholder letters
events.text: Mark Leonard, Constellation Software's founder and then-President, stopped writing his annual President's Letter to shareholders in 2018, ending a long-running tradition. Third-party commentary attributes the decision to a wish to stop sharing hard-won capital-allocation and operating tactics with an expanding field of Constellation imitators.
events.source_title: Mark Leonard Stopped Writing to Shareholders in 2018 (Eagle Talon Partners)

events.item: USD 20 per share special dividend declared
events.text: Alongside its Q4/FY2018 results (announced February 14, 2019), Constellation Software declared a special dividend of USD 20.00 per share plus the regular USD 1.00 per share quarterly dividend, both payable April 5, 2019 to shareholders of record March 16, 2019. The company said it had invested $603 million in acquisitions during 2018 at attractive rates of return, but felt it had capital in excess of its needs and should return the excess to shareholders.
events.source_title: Constellation Software Inc. Announces Results for the Fourth Quarter and Year Ended December 31, 2018 and Declares Quarterly and Special Dividends
events.note: The task's target statement that specials would end going forward was not located via WebSearch in this session; only the 'excess capital' framing quoted above was confirmed. See gaps.

events.item: 2021 President's Letter: larger deals, lower hurdle rates
events.text: In his February 2021 President's Letter, Mark Leonard said Constellation would accept a lower hurdle rate on larger acquisitions to deploy the roughly $989 million of excess cash generated in 2020, reasoning that 'if we drop our hurdle rates for these acquisitions ... competent and diligent merger and acquisition brokers will include us in more auctions.' This marked a shift from his earlier stance of keeping hurdle rates high even for large VMS deals. He also described developing 'a new circle of investing competence outside of the VMS sphere.'
events.note: News-site summary/quotation of the letter; the primary letter PDF URL was not directly retrieved via WebSearch in this session.

events.text: On January 4-5, 2021, Constellation Software completed the spin-out of Topicus.com Inc. Constellation acquired 39,412,385 Topicus shares and immediately distributed 39,412,367 of them to Constellation's common shareholders of record as of December 28, 2020, as a dividend-in-kind of 1.859817814 Topicus subordinate voting shares per Constellation common share. Constellation retained 18 Topicus shares (0.000046%), 1 super voting share, and 39,412,385 preferred shares. Topicus shares began trading on the TSX Venture Exchange on or about February 1, 2021.
events.source_title: Constellation Software Inc. Completes Spin-Out of Topicus.com Inc.

events.text: In its FY2020 results release, Constellation Software reported organic growth of negative 3% for the full year 2020 (also negative 3% after FX adjustment), and the Board 'applauded the efforts of our employees during the disruption caused by COVID-19.'
events.source_title: Constellation Software Inc. Announces Results for the Fourth Quarter and Year Ended December 31, 2020 and Declares Quarterly Dividend

events.item: Allscripts Hospitals and Large Physician Practices acquisition announced
events.text: On March 2, 2022, Constellation Software's Harris Operating Group (via subsidiary N. Harris Computer Corporation) announced an agreement to acquire Allscripts Healthcare Solutions' Hospitals and Large Physician Practices business segment (Sunrise, Paragon, Allscripts TouchWorks, Allscripts Opal, dbMotion) for up to USD 700 million (USD 670 million fixed plus up to USD 30 million contingent consideration). That business segment's gross revenue for the year ended December 31, 2021 was USD 928 million. The purchase completed May 2, 2022; the business was later rebranded Altera Digital Health.
events.source_title: Constellation Software's Harris Operating Group Acquires Allscripts Hospitals and Large Physician Practices Business Segment
events.note: Task described this as an 'early 2022' announcement; the confirmed announcement date is March 2, 2022 (not January), with completion May 2, 2022.
